name: Pylerium Manager
tagline: Your app studio’s website, store and sales, run from your desktop.
description:
Pylerium Manager builds a beautiful showcase site for your apps, publishes it free on GitHub Pages, and runs the business side for you.

- **Your website**: app cards, pages, screenshots, release notes and videos, in your brand
- **Store**: sell apps with private downloads through Stripe, with new versions reaching past buyers automatically
- **Licence keys**: every buyer gets a signed key; drop-in key checks for Python, JavaScript, C# and C/C++
- **Tax**: Stripe Tax at checkout, sales by country and a heads-up before you need to register
- **Connectors**: post to X, LinkedIn, Mastodon, Telegram and DEV, push builds to itch.io and the Chrome Web Store, with AI-drafted posts from your own Ollama model
- **Autopilot**: Discord alerts, buyer emails, a live dashboard and auto-sync of versions and prices

Every feature is free for 14 days, no card needed. Then A$19.99 a month; cancel any time.

### Storefront Comparison for Indie Developers

| Feature | Pylerium Manager | itch.io | Gumroad | Lemon Squeezy |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Hosting & Ownership** | **100% yours** (GitHub Pages + Cloudflare Workers) | Hosted on itch.io subdomain | Hosted on Gumroad storefront | Hosted on Lemon Squeezy storefront |
| **Platform Fee** | **0%** (standard Stripe processing + ~0.5% Stripe Tax if enabled) | **0%–100%** (developer-set revenue share, default 10%) | **10% flat** + payment processing | **5% + 50¢** per transaction |
| **Monthly Cost** | **$0/mo** after one-off licence (14-day free trial) | Free | Free | Free |
| **Global Tax / VAT / GST** | **Built-in Stripe Tax** (auto GST/VAT at checkout, threshold warnings, country tracking & CSV reports) | Handled for most regions (unless direct payout) | **Merchant of Record** (handles global VAT/GST & remittance) | **Merchant of Record** (handles global VAT/GST & remittance) |
| **Built-in Discovery** | **None** (you bring your own traffic) | **High** (active indie game & tool marketplace) | **Moderate** (Gumroad Discover marketplace) | **Low** (primarily direct-link checkout) |
| **Desktop Release Workflow** | **Built-in** (manage cards, notes, videos & builds locally) | Web dashboard or `butler` CLI | Web dashboard only | Web dashboard only |
requirements: A free GitHub account. Stripe, Cloudflare, Discord and Gmail are optional.

name: pyleriumTV
tagline: Turn the media on your drives into personal TV channels with a live guide.
description:
# pyleriumTV

pyleriumTV turns the media on your attached drives and local storage into personal TV channels, with a live
electronic programme guide. It is a separate app from Pylerium Purge and does not replace your launcher.


## Features

- Responsive remote-first programme guide with a live time marker, now/next details and live progress bars
- Channels built from whole folders or hand-picked files; mounted USB drives are detected automatically
- Linear playback: tuning joins a programme at its wall-clock position, never at the start
- **libVLC playback engine** — plays XviD/AVI, AC3, E-AC3 (DD+), DTS and 10-bit x265 that Android's own
  player cannot decode. Stalled or unplayable files are retried and then skipped
- Persistent Edit Mode (MENU): rename, create, clear and delete channels, assign folders or files
- Paired Pylerium studio sync: address-free LAN discovery, one-time code pairing, HMAC-signed requests and
  AES-GCM encrypted payloads. Uploads stream to the TV over an authenticated, encrypted channel, are written to a
  hidden `.part` file, verified (size + SHA-256 + MAC), fsynced and only then atomically renamed into the library.
  Free space is checked before a transfer starts, and orphaned partial files are cleaned up automatically
- Pylerium graphite, orange and cyan visual system

## Using it

1. Open pyleriumTV. On first use Android asks for full file access (needed to browse media in the built-in
   remote-friendly drive browser).
2. Press **MENU** for Edit Mode, select a channel, then add a folder or several video files.
3. Use the directional pad to browse the guide and **OK** to watch. In the player: **▲/▼** change channel,
   **OK** pauses (resuming rejoins live), **MENU** cycles audio tracks.

To send movies from a PC, open *Edit Mode → Pair Pylerium studio* on the TV and enter the six-digit code in the
Pylerium studio.

## Build

```
./gradlew assembleDebug testDebugUnitTest lintDebug
```

Requires the Android SDK (`local.properties` with `sdk.dir=...`), JDK 17+. The APK is written to
`app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk`. Application id: `com.pylerium.tv`, minSdk 26.

## Credits

Launcher UI components derive from [CleanTV](https://github.com/JohnWayneeee/cleantv) by JohnWayneeee (MIT).
See [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md) and [LICENSE](LICENSE).
